_comment: Stable Artifact URLs for DelayGuard's standing reports. A command that publishes MUST read its slug here and pass that URL as `url`, so the report updates in place instead of spawning a new artifact every run. One artifact per report TYPE — never one per run, never one shared page for all types. Add a slug here before a command publishes it; a null url means 'not published yet, create it and write the URL back'. DelayGuard pages only. The account-level ledger of every published artifact across all projects lives outside every repo, at ~/.claude/artifacts-registry.json, and ~/.claude/hooks/artifact-register.sh blocks a publish that has not reached it.
